summary: Strive, Inc. filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K on September 8, 2026 disclosing bitcoin treasury purchases of 1,375 BTC at an average price of approximately $79,281 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees, during August 31–September 4, 2026. The filing also updates holdings of cash, STRC preferred stock, and share counts, including 24,531 bitcoin held and SATA perpetual preferred shares outstanding rising to 9,995,425. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no structural or regulatory mechanics. This is a periodic treasury and capital-structure update, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
